5.4.0.notes: Kernel 5.4.x is common in Ubuntu/Debian challenge images. Triage for local-root CVEs and sudo/SUID misconfigs before attempting a kernel exploit.

5.10.0.notes: Kernel 5.10.x often appears in newer Ubuntu and Debian images; check for local privilege-escalation vectors and root-owned writable files.

5.15.0.notes: Kernel 5.15.x is commonly used in modern Linux challenge environments. Always validate the exact distro and build before assuming a CVE path.

6.1.0.notes: Kernel 6.1.x is a common modern target. Prioritize local root checks for writable scripts and sudo misconfigurations before kernel exploits.
likely_vectors: Local root CVEs tied to the exact distro build
